olivia.partnerships: Sanjay sent a supplier packet with updated spot/commit tables. We need clean inputs for cost modeling: reserve tiers, spot eviction percentiles, minimum monthly commitments, and lead times by region.
sanjay.supplier: Correct. Quick summary: support 1/3/6/12mo reserves. Marketplace SKUs in us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-west-1 at launch; asia availability via PO. Spot preempt rate: median ~10%, 95p ~22% (varies by hour).
dan.cloud: For mapping we need SKU IDs + a perf-equivalence column (A100-40GB-equivalent) and a GA flag. Also mark SKUs that are region-locked.
mike.finance: Finance asks for net $/GPU-hr after preemptions+retry overhead. Please include: reserved_hourly, spot_median_hourly, spot_95p_hourly, avg_preempt_rate, preempt_95p, min_monthly_commit, early_term_fee_pct, lead_time_weeks, marketplace_fee_pct.
sanjay.supplier: Will provide CSV with those fields + anonymized hourly eviction series (last 90 days) and a sample invoice reconciliation. For enterprise carve-outs lead time is 6-8w; standard reserved ~2w.
d an.cloud: Also add a "flexibility" field: locked / quarter-swap / fully-flex. Helps model mid-commit migrations.
mike.finance: For Monte Carlo i'll assume retry multiplier 1.15 unless vendor gives a different observed retry cost. Provide reclaim/adjustment policy for billed preemptions.
sync-bot: Reminder: supplier-upload job scheduled 2026-07-10T09:00:00Z.
olivia.partnerships: Action items: Sanjay to drop CSV + eviction series by Friday EOD. Dan to map SKUs to instance types. Mike to run P10/P50/P90 cost bands after upload. I'll follow up on announcement/PR review windows if any pricing promos are needed. :thumbsup:
